scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the class hooks off vs candidate with the hooks on), 18496 isolated CPU pairs for 54 functions of CAEScriptAudioEntity (8), CAEPoliceScannerAudioEntity (13), CAEPedAudioEntity (15) and CAEStreamingChannel (18), zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture in both legs (fake entities, fake CAEStreamingChannel of 0x60098 bytes, fake ped/physical/matrix, 8 fake CAESound, fake decoders and FAKE DirectSound/FXParamEq COM objects with own vtables; no audio singleton is touched) and compares: return value, the hash of the object under test, the hash of the physical/ped/sounds/destination buffer, the hash of the 0x60 bytes of scanner globals (0xB61CF8), the full trace of collaborator calls with arguments, the x87 control word (24-bit precision) and the restored globals (volume table 0xBD00F8 replaced by a fake and restored). Traced stubs, which get NO credit: IsSoundBankLoaded, LoadSoundBank, CAESoundManager::{CancelSoundsInBankSlot, AreSoundsPlayingInBankSlot, AreSoundsOfThisEventPlayingForThisEntity(AndPhysical), CancelSoundsOwnedByAudioEntity, RequestNewSound}, CAESound::{RegisterWithPhysicalEntity, StopSoundAndForget, SetPosition}, GetRandomNumberInRange<int>, FindPlayerPed, ReportFrontendAudioEvent, IsLoadingTuneActive, CAESmoothFadeThread::{RequestFade, CancelFade}, CAEAudioChannel::{SetFrequency, SetOriginalFrequency}, CAEAudioUtility::GetCurrentTimeInMS, CAETwinLoopSoundEntity::{Initialise, PlayTwinLoopSound, UpdateTwinLoopSound, StopSoundAndForget} and, only where the tested function calls them, ProcessMissionAudioEvent, PlayResidentSoundEvent, PlayLoadedDialogue and the Handle* of CAEPedAudioEntity. All of it on FAKE DirectSound COM; the real streaming thread is parked in IsForegroundApp during the whole bench. Limits: constructors/destructors (Script::Constructor, Scanner::Constructor/Destructor, Streaming::Destructor) mask the vptr and the CAEAudioEntity base part (m_Entity, m_tempSound), because the EXE writes only +0x10 of m_tempSound while the DLL zeroes all of it through the shared base class; the rest is compared byte by byte. The SoundDigest of sounds passed to RequestNewSound masks padding/stack garbage (+0x55, +0x40..0x4F, +0x5A..+0x5B, +0x6A..+0x6B, +0x72..+0x73). CAEStreamingChannel::InitialiseSilence with a failing CreateSoundBuffer is NOT tested (the DLL writes NOTSA_LOG_WARN, the EXE does nothing). CoInitialize (IAT 0x858350) is stubbed only during Streaming::Initialise. CAEStreamingChannel::Destructor is tested with m_pDirectSoundBuffer always non-null (the EXE does not check for null). AddFX: the eqFail fixture only fails the 2nd iteration (if the 1st failed the EXE would use an uninitialised local). Domains: sampleId 0..3, m_pPed non-null except in AddAudioEvent, non-zero channel frequencies, FillBuffer with a decoder that always advances, finite floats (no NaN/sNaN), surfaces 0..179 read from the real g_surfaceInfos (read only). Only the own part of each function is validated. Source corrected to what the EXE does before the approved run (uncommitted at the time; see reversing/AudioWave2/README.md for addresses): see source_corrections_before_run. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
